_readme: Referral/affiliate links other than Klook. Any link on the site with data-partner="<key>" gets its href set from here by scripts/apply-affiliates.cjs. When the Wise affiliate (Partnerize) link arrives, replace the wise url and re-run the script. "whatsappChannel": the WhatsApp Channel link (https://whatsapp.com/channel/...). While empty, no channel buttons appear; after setting it, rebuild pages (apply-site-chrome, build-guides, build-posts, build-video-pages, apply-affiliates).
